newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes slightly weaker.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes slightly weaker.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed slightly weaker at C$1.3716 (US$0.7291) from Tuesday's close of C$1.3703 (US$0.7298).
* Dealers said trading was quiet as investors stuck to the sidelines leading up to next week's FOMC meeting.
* Canadian trade data released Wednesday met expectations.
Expectations that the Fed could hike rates have been raised since a senior Fed official told Reuters there is a growing consensus among Fed policymakers that U.S. rates will rise 25 basis points.
Market players fear the Bank of Canada will lower rates at the same time, widening the spread between Canadian and U.S. rates and weakening the Canadian dollar, dealers said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar weakened to 1.1003 marks from Tuesday's close of 1.1024 marks and weakened to 79.56 yen from 80.27 yen.
